items.t: The Empire State Building Observation Deck Announces 2026 Holiday Celebrations
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 23, 2026--The Empire State Building (ESB), the "World's Most Famous Building," today announced its 2026 holiday celebrations, with festive décor throughout the iconic Observation Deck Experience, a Radio City Rockettes combo ticket, visits from Santa Claus, and screenings of "Home Alone 2: Lost in New York" and "Elf."
